title: An export sink stopped accepting the projection (OP-156 m.3 (s))
description: The member of the SET `events` claim, and of the CloudEvent `data.events`, under `urn:suiss:access:event:export.sink_failed`. The copy is behind; the record is unchanged and answers every audit question. A notification, never an authority source (INV-24).

sink.description: The export sink's name in the realm.

access_position.description: The event's monotone version field (OP-22): it only grows within its source, the domain for an authority event and the issuer for an identity event. A receiver that has applied a later or equal position re-queries instead of applying this event.
